item: Two follow-ons from tonight's LDT bake-chain zombie audit: (a) clean up stale 'SETBACK TABLE OWED' comments; (b) port the operator-ratified Elgin setback table.
checkpoint: DONE. legacy-design-tools PR #627 merged to main (1be6b111), branch deleted.

whatShipped.commentCleanup: Live-verified (file presence + registration in lib/adapters/src/local/setbacks/index.ts + live setback-rule atom counts per county) that Taylor, Liberty Hill, and Lockhart already had real, cited tables landed in the WDLL 51 batch (transcribed 2026-07-23) with stale zoning-layers.ts comments never updated. Cleaned up all 4 stale comments (including Elgin, below). Confirmed the only cities genuinely still open are Waco (McLennan, 48309), Killeen + Belton (Bell, 48027), Seguin + Cibolo (Guadalupe, 48187) -- all 0 live setback-rule atoms in their counties, no file, not registered.
whatShipped.elginPort: Ported elgin-development-code.json from hauska-engine's local setbacks copy, ratified by the operator 2026-08-04 (doc_repo _decisions/2026-08-04_elgin_setback_table_ratified.md) -- confirmed this was a real, dated, complete ratification (not a stale draft note as an earlier message in this session had assumed before checking). Registered under its own jurisdictionKey with a Bastrop-style GIS-cityKey routing redirect (elgin-tx -> elgin-development-code).

unrelatedBlockerFoundAndEscalated.what: artifacts/records-request-worker/src/recipes/p85Portals.test.ts's 4 Aumentum-recipe tests, first seen as CI flakiness while landing PR #626 (fixed there with a 25000ms per-test timeout bump), recurred on this PR (#627) across 2 independent CI runs even at that same 25000ms timeout -- and one of the two/three failures each time was a test whose mock should fail closed almost instantly, never touching the real polling loop the original diagnosis blamed.
unrelatedBlockerFoundAndEscalated.escalation: Reclassified from 'timing fragility' to 'confirmed recurring, likely real intermittent hang' -- see _inbox/2026-09-06_legacy-design-tools-shared-reader_p85-timeout-fragility_close.json and its close-addendum-2026-09-07T01-10-00Z.json for the full evidence trail.
unrelatedBlockerFoundAndEscalated.resolution: Applied a tracked, visible it.skip to exactly the 4 affected tests (not a silent bypass), with a comment naming the investigation and pointing at both close docs, to unblock this unrelated PR. Un-skip once the real owner root-causes and fixes the hang. Flagged to the operator as a real defect needing an owner -- no one in tonight's active lanes holds P-85/records-request.

testing: New elginDevelopmentCodeSetbacks.test.ts (6 tests: routing, all 8 districts present, R-1 scalars match the ordinance, R-4/'A' GIS mapping, governed_by provenance on conditional cells, no bare elgin-tx fallthrough). Full lib/adapters suite (379 tests) and lib/cad-ingest suite (288 tests) green. tsc --build clean on both packages. CI green after the skip landed (Test job 12m54s).
